description: Add a free app (like Forms) to the owner's account. Needs the owner signed in (browser sign-in, or an API key with the download permission). Safe to repeat: a second claim returns the same result. Accepts the app's free license (the result says which version). Paid apps can't be claimed. Pass site_domain (e.g. example.com) to record which site will run it; only the domain and app id are stored.

app.description: Same as app_id (the name get_app uses). One of the two is required.

app_id.description: App id from search_catalog, e.g. "forms". `app` is accepted too.

site_domain.description: The site this is for, as a bare domain like example.com (`site` is accepted as a short form).

name: claim_free_app
title: Claim a free app
